subject.title: fix: deliver Codex-generated images on message-tool routes

question: Should `message_tool_only` permit every trusted harness to deliver explicitly host-owned terminal artifacts without a `message(action=send)`, or should this exception remain Codex-specific or be disallowed?
rationale: The code correctly preserves the existing send-policy and room-event gates, but deciding which runtime outputs may bypass a user-selected source-reply policy is a durable product and API boundary rather than a mechanical correctness choice.

options.title: Approve the generic host-owned-artifact contract
options.body: Accept the shared attempt-result field and document that trusted harnesses may use it only for runtime-owned terminal artifacts, with focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Narrow it to the Codex path
options.body: Implement the image-delivery exception behind a Codex-owned seam until maintainers intentionally expose the behavior to other harnesses.

options.title: Keep strict message-tool suppression
options.body: Reject the exception and require native Codex image generation to use an explicit visible-delivery path instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow it to the Codex path
recommendation.body: Implement the image-delivery exception behind a Codex-owned seam until maintainers intentionally expose the behavior to other harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent history in the affected delivery policy and can clarify the intended runtime contract, although the final policy choice needs a repository decision owner.
